fishing: WHEN: Thursday evening Oct 8. Boca Grande low was 5:52p; morning high 11:53a. Solunar peak already passed (about 10:40a-12:40p). Coefficient very high. SE about 10 kt, light chop, storms likely this evening — night bridge bite is the window, not a late Gulf run. PASSES-BEACH: Waterline Oct 8 (reports Oct 6). Fishin Franks: Spanish mackerel off the beach, cobia on nearshore wrecks. Cooks Sportsland Venice: whiting, some snook and redfish off the beach; shrimp or sandfleas on the step-off at high tide. Economy Tackle Sarasota: snook off the beach and in the passes, some trout. LEMON BAY: Fine Bait North Port Oct 6 — good redfish with mixed snook, trout and black drum; Bull and Turtle Bay reds, smaller snook and trout. Fishin Franks: lots of redfish and small trout in Bull/Turtle, some reds on the West Wall. NEARSHORE: cobia schools migrating (Economy Tackle best bet); mangrove snapper 7-14 miles; grunts and smaller mangroves; snapper 50-60 ft on shrimp. Capt. Mike / Manasota Key Outfitters still no October bite note. Baits: live shrimp, sandfleas, lures and soft plastics, cut bait.
redtide: FWC Oct 2: K. brevis background only in SWFL (Sarasota samples); not observed in Charlotte, including Englewood Beach 9/30. No fish kills. Next report Oct 9.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach GOOD, no advisory — enterococci 10 on 10/5 (Healthy Beaches, page updated 10/8). Englewood Beach GOOD, last listed 20 CFU, no advisory.
fpl: Evening check about 6p: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota 148 customers out; no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
